dedupe_keys.name: reproducibility archive for offshore wind farm maintenance

description: Zhongshun Gao publishes a reproducibility archive for a study of offshore wind-farm maintenance when work-order visibility and weather access are incomplete. Zenodo lists one public archive under CC BY 4.0. The description says it contains simulation source code, parameter files, search histories, replication-level results and figure scripts. These components can support comparisons of maintenance coordination rules and weather-constrained access in a synthetic offshore wind farm. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this experiment. The case is explicitly synthetic and contains no third-party field data, so it should not be read as observed turbine failure or vessel performance. A limitation is that the public page does not specify the full algorithm, input schema, turbine count or location; those details require inspecting the archived documentation before adapting it. The related manuscript is named but publication status is not established. The archive was not downloaded, its code was not executed, and its maintenance results were not reproduced.
